description: Get narrative mindshare (each narrative's share of CoinGecko watchlist users, not social-media posts) rankings, token-level watchlist-share rows, rolling windows, or historical mindshare snapshots.

historical.description: Set to true for historical snapshots.

tokens.description: Set to true for token rows.

name: get_mindshare

snapshots.description: Oldest first. Each row's mindshare is its watchlist_users over that snapshot's total, 0 to 1. Snapshots start at the 2026-10-19 narrative coin-list change, so a timeframe reaching past it returns what follows it.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp for populated cache data; an empty string when cache data is unavailable.

mindshareChange24h.description: Always null since 2026-10-31: each coin's CoinGecko watchlist count is cached 5-8 days, so a 24-hour share change measured which coins refetched, not attention moving that day. Use mindshareChange7d or mindshareChange30d.

mindshareChange30d.description: Change in mindshare over 30 days: the difference of two shares, as a fraction (0.3566 to 0.3557 is -0.0009), not a relative change; null when no snapshot that old exists since the 2026-10-19 narrative coin-list change. Each coin's count refreshes every 5-8 days, so the change can trail by up to one refresh.

mindshareChange7d.description: Change in mindshare over 7 days: the difference of two shares, as a fraction (0.3566 to 0.3557 is -0.0009), not a relative change; null when no snapshot that old exists since the 2026-10-19 narrative coin-list change. Each coin's count refreshes every 5-8 days, so the change can trail by up to one refresh.

sentiment.description: CoinGecko up-vote share, 0 to 1; null with no vote sample. CoinGecko publishes no vote count, so a few votes can read 0 or 1. Not part of the share since 2026-10-31.

totalSocialScore.description: Sum of the narrative's coins' scores; a coin's score is its CoinGecko watchlist users (formula v3, 2026-10-31).

mindshareChange24h.description: Always null since 2026-10-31: each coin's CoinGecko watchlist count is cached 5-8 days, so a 24-hour share change measured which coins refetched, not attention moving that day. Use mindshareChange7d or mindshareChange30d.

mindshareChange7d.description: Always null: token-level 7-day history is not retained.

sentiment.description: CoinGecko up-vote share, 0 to 1; null with no vote sample. CoinGecko publishes no vote count, so a few votes can read 0 or 1. Not part of the share since 2026-10-31.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Mindshare data
